n: Joel says afterward; Peter says in the last days and adds saith God. The order of old men and young men is swapped.
My law in their inward parts becomes my laws into their mind; the rest follows closely.
Jesus keeps the promise word for word and frames it as a blessing; the Psalm's second half is not quoted.
Good tidings unto the meek becomes the gospel to the poor, and recovering of sight to the blind appears. In the next verse Jesus stops at the acceptable year, before Isaiah's day of vengeance.
Paul quotes only the command to love. In Leviticus it stands against vengeance and grudges and is sealed with I am the LORD.
Isaiah: we are healed. Peter, writing to his readers: ye were healed.
Jesus repeats John the Baptist's warning almost word for word.
